top_signals.title: Gold Tilts Lower as Iran Impasse Continues to Fan Rate-Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: Gold was set to end to the week lower as elevated energy prices and inflation concerns drove bond yields higher and fueled expectations the Federal Reserve will need to raise interest rates further.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Pomp prevails over substance as Trump hosts Xi
top_signals.summary: Fanfare masks some of the US president’s own troubles, including his war in Iran and plummeting domestic popularity
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
